definition: the time of your life when you are a child
description: A family hallway with framed paintings and a wooden floor. A young woman in a yellow jacket, far too big for it, sits squeezed into a small red toy pedal car and rolls towards the viewer, laughing, with a teddy bear on her shoulder. A beagle trots beside her. Behind her a young man takes a toy drum out of an old wooden toy chest and lifts it up over his head, and a wooden rocking horse stands by the wall. Warm light comes through the glass front door.
